crime: Every evening, {WITCH_NAME}'s friend sat in the chair by the lounge window mending the other girls' torn clothes, and {WITCH_NAME} sat beside her. At eight each night, when {WITCH_NAME} looked into the window to check tomorrow, her friend waved at the glass, and the girl in tomorrow's reflection waved back.

One evening at eight, {WITCH_NAME} showed the other prisoners the lounge as it would be at that hour tomorrow. In the window, her friend sat bowed over her mending beside an empty chair. {WITCH_NAME} watched for the wave. The hand in the glass never rose.
Her friend laughed. "Stop checking tomorrow. I'm right here."
On his last evening, {WITCH_NAME}'s father had told her, "Stop watching the door. I'm right here." By morning, his chair was empty.

The next evening, a little before eight, {WITCH_NAME} stood behind her friend's chair and strangled her until she slumped over her mending. Then she went upstairs to the recreation room and was sitting among the other girls when eight o'clock came.
At nine, a prisoner found {WITCH_NAME}'s friend dead in her chair.

At the trial, the prisoners ruled that she must have died after eight. Hadn't the window, a day ahead, shown her at her mending at eight o'clock? And at eight, {WITCH_NAME} had been sitting upstairs with them. Then one prisoner remembered the wave. At eight, in the glass, her hand had never risen. She had not been bowed over her mending; she had been slumped over it, dead before {WITCH_NAME} ever went upstairs.
fields.epitaph: Her friend stayed right here, just as she promised.
fields.epithet: The Girl Who Checks Tomorrow for Empty Chairs
execution: In the trial court, the execution stand straps her flat on her back. Above her hangs an iron-backed mirror, face down.
The mirror begins to lower, and she watches her own face come down to meet her.
It settles on her chest and bears down.
At last the mirror lies flat on her, her hands still at its edges.

magic.name: Tomorrow's Glass
magic.text: She can look into a mirror or window and see the same place as it will be tomorrow.
